episodes.name: Prime Time
episodes.overviewEn: Hardcase, Prototype, and Prime team up to battle NM-E as he tries to steal nuclear missiles from an army base. After NM-E escapes with the missiles, Ghoul and Contrary teleport the three heroes to Ultra headquarters and attempt to recruit them into Ultraforce

episodes.name: The Stuff of Heroes
episodes.overviewEn: Atalon, the king of the fire people continues his attack on humanity by launching several missiles at several locations. Pixx manages to stop some by using her computer, but she is unable to stop three which need to be disarmed manually

episodes.name: Armageddon
episodes.overviewEn: Whilst Atalon continues his attack against humankind Ultraforce find out where he is keeping the missiles. They devise a plan to stop him and the rest of the fire people, which results in one team member making a great sacrifice

episodes.name: Lord Pumpkin's Pie
episodes.overviewEn: Whilst Atalon continues his attack against humankind Ultraforce find out where he is keeping the missiles. They devise a plan to stop him and the rest of the fire people, which results in one team member making a great sacrifice

episodes.name: You Can't Go Home Again
episodes.overviewEn: Memebers of the Ultraforce Reflect upon their lives

episodes.name: Night and the Nightman
episodes.overviewEn: Johnny Domino is the latest ultra to emerge from the cable car accident. As he comes to terms with his new abilities Ultraforce are keen to recruit him, but he is more set on finding the evil Chrysalis, who is wrapping humans in cocoons and stealing their appearances

episodes.name: A Veiled Threat
episodes.overviewEn: Hardcase's latest co-star Veil is hiding a secret from him, that she has ultra abilities. Topaz and Ghoul think she is hiding something else and start to delve into her past history revealing a lot more than they expected

episodes.name: Pump It Up!
episodes.overviewEn: Lord Pumpkin has returned. We as learn that Ghoul name Jonathan

episodes.name: Primal Scream
episodes.overviewEn: One of Ultraforce's enemies mysteriously returns, whilst Kevin is having problems controlling his alter-ego Prime

episodes.name: Everything That Rises Must Converge
episodes.overviewEn: The passengers of a cable car, hit by a cosmic lightening bolt, return with Ultra abilities and form a team known as 'The Strangers'. Hardcase believes that the same cosmic power gave him his abilities several years ago and investigates

episodes.name: Jumpin' at the Boneyard
episodes.overviewEn: The Ultraforce battles at the Boneyard
